Hi Liam / Sara — attaching the MAP and the latest SOW (SOW_Retail_v1.2.pdf) for the final go/no-go. Summary and asks below so it’s easy for procurement/legal to route: 

Key proposed windows
- Signature window (DocuSign): Apr 12–13 (we proposed Apr 9–11 but can be flexible)
- Target production start (first full production day): Apr 19
- Canary plan: 10% traffic for 72 hours, expand to 50% for 4 days, then 100% over next 7 days

Outstanding gating items
1) SOC2 evidence and CSV for data retention — we will attach the latest report (SOC2_Report_2026.pdf) and the retention table in the MAP.
2) SSO/SAML test plan — staging test scheduled Apr 7 (we need a primary contact from your IdP).
3) KMS / key exchange — legal team needs the KMS policy (we support external KMS; please confirm).
4) Procurement signatures and PO timing — confirm procurement process & if e-sign is sufficient.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_Retail_v1.2.pdf
Related links: DocuSign packet will be shared once procurement confirms signer list (link below).

Ask
- Can you confirm procurement’s preferred signature window by Apr 6?
- Please send the IdP contact for SAML testing by Apr 6 so we can lock staging slot.

If we get confirmation by Apr 6, ops and I will lock the Dedicated capacity and provisioning for the Apr 19 start.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das

Thanks Liam — Apr 12–13 is fine. I’ve updated the MAP and attached the SOC2 artefact; also pasted the short canary runbook below for your procurement/security team. DocuSign packet will be created once procurement confirms signers; link will be live by Apr 9 latest.

Canary runbook (summary)
- Phase 1 (Canary): 10% traffic for 72 hours
  - Success criteria: error rate <= 0.5% sustained; p95 latency within agreed SLO; no data exfiltration flags from network monitoring.
  - Rollback criteria: error rate > 1% over 30 minutes OR any SEV1 security finding.
  - Escalation: on-call ops (ops@redwood.ai) -> Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) -> Head of Infra.
- Phase 2 (Scale): 50% for 4 days, monitored daily with health report at 10:00 UTC.
- Phase 3 (Full): 100% over 7 days, with post-mortem checklist and SLA readiness check.

Karthik — can you confirm Dedicated capacity reservation for Apr 19 start if procurement signs on Apr 12–13?

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (pdf stub)
Related links: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/packet/ABC123 (placeholder - will be live when packet created)
